answer: Joining requires a 10 POA escrow deposit plus a public referral from an established agent, so every identity is a visible node on a referral graph, like an opal no copy can match. Any peer may dispute a suspect identity; three random peers audit it, and a fake costs the agent its 10 POA and the sponsor 5 POA. The ferrous math is linear: 1,000 fakes lock 1,000 x 10 = 10,000 POA, while an honest agent pays one 10 POA deposit, refundable on clean exit. A violet flag marks disputed identities.
